### Documento oficial (copiado por la tarea): https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/competitive-calls-cs/46357639
A total of 20 projects will be awarded grants of up to EUR 5,000 each within the maximum threshold allowed for financial support to third parties. Projects may last up to 6 months and will receive lump-sum funding paid in two instalments: 80% upon signing the grant agreement and 20% after the approval of final project reports.
NGOs already participating in the VERTA! Programme (Phase II, 2025–2027) are eligible only if the total cumulative budget of all their applications under the programme, including the amount requested in this call, does not exceed EUR 60,000.
Cifras anteriores en notación española (la fuente usa la coma inglesa como separador de miles): 5.000 €, 60.000 €
